mechanism.claim: During elevated realized variation, a canonical Negative Volume Index crossing its 255-period exponential signal on completed four-hour BTC auctions identifies a change in the price path formed specifically during declining-volume auctions; follow the new relation for twenty-four hours.
mechanism.side: long when NVI crosses strictly above its signal EMA; short on the strict reverse crossover
mechanism.why_distinct: HVNVI updates a multiplicative price index only when completed base volume declines versus the prior bar and otherwise carries its prior state. It is not a continuously weighted volume oscillator, Force Index, taker flow, OI, funding, premium, or Gross9 primitive.
mechanism.why_suited_to_volatile_regimes: completed trailing twenty-four-hour realized variation must rank in its causal upper 35%, restricting low-participation path regime changes to July-like volatile conditions
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: sparse stateful declining-volume price-index signal crossings are absent from Gross9 primitives

features.source_bar: exact aggregation of 240 coherent BTCUSDT one-minute rows [T-4h,T), including summed base volume
features.negative_volume_index: causal multiplicative index initialized at 1000 at the first valid bar after any gap; update by close ratio only on a strict base-volume decline; carry unchanged otherwise
features.signal: 255-period EMA of NVI, alpha=2/256, adjust=false, minimum 255 consecutive valid bars
features.cross: strict current NVI/signal crossover from immediately prior valid state
features.variation: sqrt(sum squared completed five-minute open-to-close log returns over [T-24h,T)), finite strict positive
features.variation_rank: strict-prior midrank over at most 180 earlier valid decisions, minimum 120, current excluded; rank>=0.65

clock.feature_available: four-hour boundary after completed source bar
clock.entry: exact BTCUSDT open five elapsed minutes later
clock.reservation: global half-open first-eligible reservation; exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only after novelty passes

economic_gates.accounting: fixed quantity, exact funding, 6bp base and 10bp stress per notional side, every held 5m favorable then adverse, global HWM, full-calendar CAGR

post_stage_volatility_audit.prerequisite: unchanged candidate passes train, test, eval, final

source_plan.execution_prices: sealed until source support and Gross9 novelty pass

research_boundary.selection_basis: canonical Negative Volume Index 255-period signal crossover under the requested high-variation regime

stopping_rule: Terminal first failure; no index update, initial value, signal period, crossover, variation, side, hold, clock, subset, threshold, or control repair.

external_basis.origin: Paul Dysart / Norman Fosback canonical Negative Volume Index convention
external_basis.fixed_definition: initialize NVI at 1000; when current completed volume is below prior completed volume, NVI=current prior NVI*(current close/prior close), otherwise unchanged; 255-period EMA signal with adjust=false; strict line crossover
external_basis.selection_use: published state update, initial value, signal period, and direction only; no incidence or outcomes
